system.description:
The Aldorethi art of illusion: scholarship and precision disguised as entertainment.

  • Precise Focus: Advantage on Fortitude saves to keep an illusion going while attacked, damaged or grappled.
  • Aldorethi Insight: Advantage to identify or counter another illusionist's work, and on Detect Magic for Aldorethi illusions.
